title: 4chan whistleblower: fewer bodies found in crashed craft

tellings.quote: Um and so now he's like we see he's like we see a lot less bodies in these crafts.

plain: An anonymous poster on 4chan, an online message board where users post without names, claimed to be an insider and said that crashed alien craft recovered by the US now contain far fewer bodies than they used to. Chris Ramsay, a guest who follows UFO claims closely, relays the thread to Michels, quoting the poster as saying "we see a lot less bodies in these crafts." If true, it would suggest the craft being recovered are increasingly unpiloted.
